estimates.title: US Forest Service · Rocking Chair, snow plowing rate build-up

totals.label: Adopted rate per mile, at 1 mile an hour

notes: Winter road snow plowing, not new-road construction.

The adopted356USD/mile equals (130+56) +170, consistent with1mile/hour production and1700USD mobilization spread over10hours. This is an arithmetic interpretation of the source notes; do not treat it as a general mobilization rule.

The source explicitly reduces modeled plowings from16to10 partly to compensate for per-pass mobilization even though equipment is expected to remain onsite. This reveals a modeling workaround; production and mobilization should be modeled separately when reusing the method.
